spans.s: 1 रुप् रु॑प्यति have racking pain in the belly.
2 रु॑प् f. the earth.
रूपकरूपक n. a kind of Rūpaka ((rh.)).
रूपकार m. maker of images, sculptor.

रूपकृ॑त् a. forming, shaping;
 m. = prec.
1 रूपगुण a. possessing the quality of colour.
2 रूपगुण m. beauty of form or appearance.
रूपगुणोपेत a. beautiful.
रूपतस् adv. according to form, from without.

रूपधर a. having the colour, shape, or form of
(—˚).

रूप˚धारिन् a. having the colour, shape, or form of
(—˚).
रूपधृत् a. = prec.
रूप˚भृत् a. = prec.
रूपनाशिन् a. destroying form or beauty, disfiguring.
रूपयौवनवन्त् a. possessing beauty and youth.
रूपविपर्यय m. change of bodily form.
रूपश॑स् adv. according to peculiar formation.
रूपशालिन् a. handsome, beautiful.
रूपसंपद् f. perfection of form, beauty.
रूपसंपन्न a. endowed with beauty.
रूपिदारक m. a fine boy.*
रूपि॑न् a. = रूपवन्त्.

रूप्य a. to be (being) metaphorically indicated;
 n. silver.
रूप्यद a. giving silver.
रूप्यरज्जु f. a rope of silver.
